'''Tooke-trap plants''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of carnivorous plant that were native to the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]]-occupied [[Gungan Swamp|swamps]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biology==
[[File:TookeTrapPlant-TGF.jpg|left|thumb|A tooke-trap plant]]
They were carnivorous plants that possessed between one and four stalks, each with a "mouth" on the end, that protruded from a leafy central bush. Though these plants could survive solely on water and sunlight like a normal plant, tooke-traps also preyed on small rodents and small arthropods (especially insects). Their main prey was the [[Tooke/Legends|tooke]], from which the species derived its common name. Because the fragrance it emitted was identical to that of tooke mating pheromones, tookes found it irresistible. [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] found the carnivorous plants to be excellent house plants.

Tooke-trap plants would sometimes form a symbiotic relationship with [[Shiro/Legends|shiros]], where the reptiles rolled in mud and collected dirt and seeds between shell ridges. From this, tooke-traps grew and flourished in these "soil pockets" creating a symbiotic relationship nicknamed a "[[shiro-trap]]": tooke-traps provided camouflage for shiros against enemies like [[saw-toothed grank]]s, and in return the shiros provided locomotion for their tooke-trap passengers.

Tooke-traps themselves were food for [[clodhopper]]s.
